subject: MATH251
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering all topics. The chosen videos are highly relevant, from reputable channels with strong view counts, and directly address the specified student difficulties. For English, selections include content from Khan Academy, blackpenredpen, and Professor Dave. For Arabic, selections leverage university open courseware and popular educational creators like Engineer Passion. All hard gates and constraints were met.

coverage.note: Several candidates were too specific, proving only one property, or failed the duration/view count gates.
